correctness.rationale: The unordered cubical model applies by the published n=2 subdivision criterion (Q3 girth 4). Explicit signed boundaries on 28 zero-, 72 one- and 42 two-cells have exact integer ranks 27 and 39, independently confirmed modulo 2; all 48 signed coordinate group actions commute with both boundaries. A three-dimensional rational kernel basis of the top differential transforms with the natural signed-coordinate trace. Euler–Poincaré determines the first-homology trace; exact checks on all 48 elements establish the stated direct-sum character, and finite-group rational transfer proves the quotient statements. No unproved integer torsion or higher-cube claim is made.

value.rationale: Q3 is the canonical smallest three-dimensional cube and a three-connected planar graph. Its full B3 action on two-particle homology is a natural, symmetry-sensitive topological invariant of collision-free motion. The degree-two representation equals the defining signed-coordinate module and H1 has three distinct irreducible symmetry types, explaining a nontrivial distinction between the rational homology of the rotation quotient and that of the full-automorphism quotient. Ordinary Betti numbers and graph braid generator counts do not determine this information.
